summary: This note is a short biographical wiki entry on Paul McIntosh, born March 13, 1953, a former professional ice hockey player. It covers his brief NHL career with the Buffalo Sabres, his coaching and general manager roles with the London Knights of the Ontario Hockey League, a 1998 CHL Executive of the Year award, and his current role as Head Professional scout for the Dallas Stars.
one_line: Paul McIntosh is a former ice hockey player, OHL coach and general manager, and current Dallas Stars head professional scout.
key_facts: Paul McIntosh was born on March 13, 1953.
Paul McIntosh is a former professional ice hockey player.
Paul McIntosh played 48 games for the Buffalo Sabres in the mid-1970s.
After retiring, Paul McIntosh coached the London Knights of the Ontario Hockey League in the early 1980s.
Paul McIntosh served as General Manager of the London Knights for much of the 1990s.
Paul McIntosh won CHL Executive of the Year in 1998.
Paul McIntosh is currently the Head Professional scout for the Dallas Stars.
